title: Derived Leray composition
statement: Let f : Y ⟶ X and g : Z ⟶ Y be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let M be an arbitrary object of the unbounded derived category of abelian etale sheaves on Z [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Denote the derived direct images of the inverse-image adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] by R_f and R_g, their canonical mate composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] by D : R_g followed by R_f ≅ R_(g ≫ f), and the canonical Leray comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] by lambda_h : R_h followed by RGamma_(target h) ≅ RGamma_(source h). Then RGamma_X(D_M) followed by lambda_(g ≫ f),M equals lambda_f,R_g(M) followed by lambda_g,M. There is no boundedness restriction on M.

proof.text: The private helper lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso_comp_comp proves the underived composition equation in the specialized case h = f ≫ g and hh = rfl. Cancel the terminal-evaluation isomorphism on the right, use its naturality, and expand lowerStarCompSheafSectionsTerminalIso and lowerStarComp. The remaining equality is between maps into the iterated pullback of the terminal object; terminalIsTerminal.hom_ext identifies them. This is the same terminal-section argument as the proved private helper in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.UnderivedGlobalGermExchange, specialized without any stalk or base-change hypotheses.

proof.text: The private helper derived_comp_eq applies the proved source theorem Adjunction.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'_hom_eq_conjugateEquiv to the three inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions and lowerStarComp. Its hypothesis is precisely conjugateIsoEquiv_upperStarComp. Unfolding rightDerivedLowerStarComp identifies its hom with Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso' applied to lowerStarComp. The helper comp_fac then gives the equation obtained by precomposing each such derived comparison with rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit, using rightDerivedUnique and rightDerivedNatTrans_fac.

proof.text: Write F=g_*, G=f_*, H=Gamma_X, K=(g≫f)_*, J=Gamma_Y and L=Gamma_Z. F, G and F⋙G preserve K-injectives. Transport the right-derived structure of R(F⋙G)⋙RH along rightDerivedFunctorCompIso F G whiskered by RH. Its unit alpha at a homotopy object T is the H-derived unit at G(F(T)), followed by RH applied to the F,G composite unit. Apply Functor.rightDerived_ext with alpha. On the left, comp_fac for F,G converts the direct-image comparison, naturality of the H-derived unit moves the underived direct-image comparison to the front, and comp_fac for K,H gives Qh(H(e_T);c_T) followed by the L-derived unit. On the right, naturality of the G,H comparison at the F-derived unit, then comp_fac for G,H and F,J, gives Qh(a_F(T);b_T) followed by the same L-derived unit. The equation of step 1 lifts degreewise to cochain complexes and then through the homotopy quotient and Qh, identifying these expressions. Evaluate the resulting natural-transformation equation at M.

theorem derivedLeray_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g f).hom.app M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g ≫ f)).hom.app M =
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).hom.app
        ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).hom.app M
